issue.title: Restore the original dev-only multidimensional work counter contract
issue.description:
Reconcile .5.3 original four-dimension dev-mode observation with the actual current three-field repaint record. WorkCounts currently contains tiles_redrawn:u32,pixels_damaged:u64,full_frame:bool; compositor RetainedRenderState.latest_work and both full/scoped writes are ungated; compositor and telemetry have no feature tables, and runtime dev-mode=[] does not propagate counting. Original layout/raster/upload observations are absent. The existing canonical one-node/fallback/overlap/idle gates exercise useful repaint behavior, so retain that real behavior and its assertions while delivering the authorized measurement boundary and dimensions. Do not remove WorkCounts merely because its drain has only test readers; the production writes are live and .5.3 is its retained counter owner.

Independently accepted evidence PR1375 actually MERGED 2026-10-06T12:17:12Z, squash fed8a020033a235e6de1032a32e2a9799f46d408 reachable current main. Full corrected evidence head abbcfc63caf32caa0786c29d905d7cbe8bd44c99 and source582/history8f qualified; historical line numbers are navigation. Source-derived gaps are UNEXECUTED, not empirical red results. Current full ALL/related complete fields deduped; retain related hud-w2t3x/hud-ddm2g, telemetry3.11 and other live owners separately. Dedupe key T8.2-gen2:W2.
issue.design:
Authority is full .5.3 description/design (explicit four fields and dev-mode), parent5, current docs/vision.md proportional work and scope Working rules. Current exact owners: telemetry/src/work_counts.rs11 and lib.rs13/37; compositor/src/renderer/retained.rs45 private latest_work, begin_observation_frame118, scoped observation154, full observation177 and public take_work_counts189. frame.rs full/retained headless callers own real submission. Exactly9 current drain call expressions exist:7 inline runtime headless tests and2 compositor retained_image tests; no production/benchmark/T7 drain call exists. This does not erase the live producer. Restore documented four work dimensions through real existing preparation/raster/upload/damage owner operations, with explicit integer units and per-frame reset/drain semantics. Define exact four units without a new measurement framework: layout:u64 is the per-frame delta of existing TextRasterizer.shape_call_count (cache-miss shaping invocations, text.rs759/1628); raster:u64 is the sum of existing per-instance raster_count deltas (entered rasterize_and_upload invocations, not guaranteed successful rasters); upload:u64 counts actual widget RGBA queue.write_texture submissions at widget.rs2912; damage_px:u64 is clipped repaint-region pixels from PixelRect.area. Preserve the existing three repaint fields as supplemental observations with their9 current real test consumers; they never replace the four required dimensions. Keep raw existing shaping/raster counters live and unchanged; only the new WorkCounts observation/storage/writes/drain is dev/test opt-in. This narrowly defines existing measurable operations, not all glyphon/resource/static-image GPU uploads. A zero upload field therefore means zero observed widget RGBA submissions and never certifies an empty atlas/upload queue. Reuse existing per-instance widget raster counters/last-sync plumbing; never infer layout/raster/upload by copying tiles_redrawn, fabricate0 for an unobserved dimension, or claim a general no-upload result from the AB/BA glyph-inventory fixture. External glyphon work that cannot be observed must be explicitly bounded/documented, not silently counted as measured. Keep the current tiles_redrawn/pixels_damaged/full_frame repaint/fallback assertions and readers as explicit supplemental dev observations. This retains a current user rather than deleting instrumentation to make the type spelling match. Gate the observation storage/writes/hook and reexports behind dev/test configuration, propagate an opt-in existing dev-mode path through runtime/compositor/telemetry, and make existing selected tests opt in without changing the normal app default closure or silently dropping their targets. Counter gating must not disable retained rendering, its snapshots, widget/frame telemetry, cache work or GPU submission. Do not recreate the removed invalidation artifact or grow a certification API. Update all9 exact readers and existing canonical_one_node_update_repaints_only_the_changed_tile, transparent-overlap/fallback/recovery, static/no-render and new_observation_clears_prior_frame_work_counts assertions to observe the real dimensions/retained pixel behavior. Existing names stay. Correct telemetry lib stale Soak/DR-V8 module claim as part of this current counter documentation; .5.4 removed that owner. This is not a new soak.

dependencies.description:

Non-goals: Making test-gpu-pixel-readback blocking in CI (escalation bead); changing any test's assertions.

Governing spec: docs/scope.md T8 row (delete code without a current user; behavior tests tied to docs/invariants.md; resource tests; llvmpipe recipe; strip pre-reset refs) and 'Working rules' (prefer deleting over generalizing; tests guard behavior a user would notice, not internal structure); docs/vision.md; docs/invariants.md; CLAUDE.md Rules; AGENTS.md (just recipes).

T7 boundary: do not edit crates/tze_hud_projection/**, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/portal_projection_driver.rs, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/portal.rs, crates/tze_hud_input/src/{composer_draft,portal_resize}.rs, crates/tze_hud_config/src/portal_tokens.rs, crates/tze_hud_mcp/src/portal_op.rs or tests/integration/text_stream_portal_*.rs; keep every pub item those files import until T7 (epic hud-lirh2) lands.

dependencies.design:
Files:
- justfile:17-26 (GPU hint names the wrong crate and a non-existent `just test-gpu-pixel-readback`), :52-59 (`test`)
- crates/tze_hud_compositor/src/renderer/tests.rs:14, :198-214 (`make_compositor_and_surface`), per-file GPU helpers in crates/tze_hud_compositor/tests/*.rs
- crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/test_support.rs:10 (`HEADLESS_RUNTIME_MUTEX`, the pattern to mirror)
- AGENTS.md:27-29, :162-163; CLAUDE.md 'Commands'; README.md pixel_readback mentions

Evidence:
Host has llvmpipe (/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json, mesa-vulkan-drivers 23.2.1) next to nvidia_icd.json. Recorded hangs were NVIDIA driver threads (AGENTS.md:162-163). HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1 only sets force_fallback_adapter (compositor renderer/mod.rs:704-716); the Vulkan loader still loads the NVIDIA ICD. ~163 compositor GPU tests each build a device with no serialization; the compositor has only ENV_VAR_MUTEX. pixel_readback lives in crates/tze_hud_runtime/tests/pixel_readback.rs, not the compositor.

Approach:
1. Add a process-wide GPU mutex to the compositor test helpers (mirror HEADLESS_RUNTIME_MUTEX) and use it in every device-creating helper.
2. Add to justfile:
   lvp := "/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json"
   test-gpu: VK_ICD_FILENAMES={{lvp}} HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1 LLVMPIPE_CI=1 TZE_HUD_REQUIRE_GPU=1 timeout 900 cargo test -p tze_hud_compositor --all-targets; then the same env for `cargo test -p tze_hud_runtime --test pixel_readback --features headless,dev-mode`.
3. Set VK_ICD_FILENAMES in `just test` too (only when the lvp ICD file exists, so CI is unaffected).
4. Replace the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md deadlock warnings with 'use `just test-gpu`'; fix the wrong crate name; document PROTOC.
5. If lvp still hangs, fall back to `-- --test-threads=1` for the GPU binaries.

Tests:
None deleted or added; gpu_canary.rs stays the guard.

Expected delta: +40 / -25

Every test named in docs/invariants.md is kept, or moved/renamed with docs/invariants.md updated in the same PR. Local builds on this host need `PROTOC=$HOME/.local/protoc/bin/protoc` (/usr/bin/protoc 3.12 fails on types.proto).

dependencies.title: Idle with content on screen: no frames between events
dependencies.description:
Goal: a notification counting down to its fade and a focused composer cost no frames between events, AND overlay click capture (notification actions, the x, widget hover, portal clicks) keeps working when the HUD is idle.

Why: `has_inflight_animation` treats a notification counting down as in flight (crates/tze_hud_compositor/src/renderer/animation.rs:738-747), so a visible notification redraws at 60 fps for its whole TTL; the composer caret renders at 60 fps (renderer/mod.rs:1583-1601) instead of waking every 530 ms (image_cache.rs:137), pinned by `idle_render_gate_renders_for_composer_echo_and_caret_blink` (renderer/tests.rs:9755). Overlay passthrough flips only in about_to_wait (crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/mod.rs:817-821 -> windowed/hittest.rs:184-244, GetCursorPos): it works today only because the 60 fps redraw polls it, so fixing idle alone breaks clicks. The two changes must land together.

Non-goals: damage-rect presentation; the Windows CPU/click verification itself (needs-human sign-off bead).
Governing spec: docs/scope.md 'POC acceptance' Idle and Zones (action reaches hud_input); CLAUDE.md rule 'Idle costs ~nothing'; docs/invariants.md §1. Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (content identical to main@1eb8f7cb, the merge of PR #1245); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey that produced this bead is not persisted; everything needed is in this bead.
dependencies.design:
Files: crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/hittest.rs:184-244; windowed/mod.rs:817-821, :1683-1731 (TtlDeadline min); windowed/wake.rs; crates/tze_hud_compositor/src/renderer/animation.rs:738-747; renderer/mod.rs:1583-1601; renderer/tests.rs:9755 (rewrite).
Approach: (1) input capture: arm a low-rate cursor poll (e.g. 30 Hz via WaitUntil) only while interactive hit regions exist and the window is in passthrough; on a hit, flip passthrough off. (WH_MOUSE_LL hook is the heavier alternative; prefer the poll.) (2) idle: a countdown is not in flight; expose `next_animation_deadline()` (fade start, next caret toggle) and fold it into the TtlDeadline min.
Tests added: `cursor_poll_armed_only_with_hit_regions` (wake-source unit), `notification_countdown_is_not_inflight_animation`, `caret_blink_wakes_at_toggle_not_every_frame`, `idle_with_notification_renders_only_at_fade` (frame counter over a TestClock window). Rewritten: `idle_render_gate_renders_for_composer_echo_and_caret_blink`. Kept: `sixty_seconds_of_static_idle_has_zero_runtime_wakeups` (wake.rs:524), `idle_render_gate_skips_static_scene_renders_on_change_or_animation`, crates/tze_hud_runtime/tests/idle_efficiency_counters.rs (idle counters stay zero with no hit regions).
Windows click/CPU verification lives in the POC needs-human sign-off bead.

2. `just test` passes including notification_countdown_is_not_inflight_animation, caret_blink_wakes_at_toggle_not_every_frame and idle_with_notification_renders_only_at_fade (filter: `HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1 cargo test -p tze_hud_compositor <name>`).
3. `cargo test -p tze_hud_runtime sixty_seconds_of_static_idle_has_zero_runtime_wakeups` passes.
